format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: a checkbox tag is a native toggle button

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#t-check button.sf-tag'); return b && b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'false' && b.classList.contains('sf-tag--checkbox'); })()

probes.title: a press toggles active and sends change with {active}
Space on the focused tag toggles it
the remove action sends sf-tag-close, then the dated close, without the element

steps.check: (() => { let detail = null; document.querySelector('#t-rm').addEventListener('sf-tag-close', (e) => { detail = e.detail; }, {once: true}); document.querySelector('#t-rm sf-button-close button').click(); return detail && !('component' in detail); })()

probes.title: absent closable, the icon kind removes and the default kind does not
type still routes a status word to status, noted with its dates
the kind quantity is default, noted with its dates
a disabled tag sends no change

steps.script: (() => { window.__tagChanges = 0; document.querySelector('#t-off').addEventListener('change', () => { window.__tagChanges += 1; }); document.querySelector('#t-off button').click(); return true; })()

probes.title: on a line the tag is one size down and inline
the remove action is named by the page's word
a filter tag shows no mark until chosen; chosen, a check mark (the icon check) on the primary container fill (C145 (2))

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#t-free'); const root = el.querySelector('button.sf-tag'); const probe = document.createElement('i'); probe.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--sf-primary-container)'; el.append(probe); const want = getComputedStyle(probe).backgroundColor; probe.remove(); return Boolean(el.querySelector('sf-icon[icon="check"]')) && root.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' && getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor === want; })()

probes.title: href makes the tag one native link with no check mark and no cross; an unsafe scheme is dropped (C145 (6))

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#t-link'); const a = el.querySelector(':scope > a.sf-tag.sf-tag--link'); return Boolean(a) && a.getAttribute('href') === '/tags/a11y' && !el.querySelector('button') && !el.querySelector('.sf-tag-check') && getComputedStyle(a.querySelector('.sf-tag-container')).textDecorationLine === 'none'; })()

probes.title: kind color draws a dot of the palette hue at the point step (8 on the default tag); the tag stays neutral; a hex takes the nearest hue (C145 (7))

steps.check: (() => { const dot = document.querySelector('#t-dot .sf-tag-color-icon'); const r = dot.getBoundingClientRect(); const free = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#t-rm .sf-tag')).backgroundColor; return dot.classList.contains('sf-hue-teal') && Math.round(r.width) === 8 && Math.round(r.height) === 8 && getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#t-dot .sf-tag')).backgroundColor === free && document.querySelector('#t-hex .sf-tag-color-icon').classList.contains('sf-hue-teal'); })()
